name: Daniel
lede: The twenty-seventh book of the Bible, in full: Daniel and his companions in the court of Babylon, the image of gold, silver, brass, iron and clay, the burning fiery furnace, the writing on the wall, the den of lions, and the visions of the four beasts, the seventy weeks and the time of the end, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: A Stone Cut Out Without Hands
books.blurb: Jerusalem besieged and the vessels carried to Shinar; Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah in the king's palace, renamed, who would not defile themselves with the king's dainties — prove thy servants ten days; then Nebuchadnezzar's dream that none could tell, the decree to slay the wise men, the secret revealed in a vision of the night, and the great image: head of gold, breast of silver, belly of brass, legs of iron, feet of iron and clay, and the stone that became a great mountain.

books.name: The Burning Fiery Furnace
books.blurb: The image of gold in the plain of Dura, and the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery and dulcimer; three men who would not bow down — our God whom we serve is able to deliver us, but if not; the furnace heated seven times more, and four men loose walking in the midst of the fire; then the king's own letter: the tree whose height reached unto heaven, the watcher and the holy one, is not this great Babylon?, seven times, and the King of heaven praised.

books.name: The Den of Lions
books.blurb: Belshazzar's feast with the vessels of the temple, and the writing upon the plaster of the wall; the queen remembers Daniel — let thy gifts be to thyself: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN; in that night Belshazzar slain; then Darius the Mede, the presidents' plot and the interdict signed; Daniel at his windows open toward Jerusalem; the den and the sealed stone; O Daniel, servant of the living God — my God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths.
